title: Phone-to-USB-C connection failing
body: As title. When attempting to plug in my phone to a USB-C port, some errors are thrown up in the dmesg and the device is not recognised (the kernel claims it never received a legible device descriptor). The ports seem physically fine: the cable still carries power to the phone, and Windows recognises the phone when it's plugged into these same USB-C ports.
